TextBlock.Text: THEATRE Banda Sea, south of Seram
DATE 17 November 2028 · 0650 local
SIDE Royal Australian Navy
WINDOW 75 min, closes at 112
SH-60K — JMSDF. Photo: Los688 · CC0 · cropped
"Air superiority is not guaranteed. It must be earned every day."
- Gen. Kenneth S. Wilsbach, Chief of Staff, US Air Force, 2025

BANDA SEA, SOUTH OF SERAM, 0650. JS Hyuga and JS Asahi are coming south out of the Manipa Strait for the Kai Islands and Common Sea. A hundred and fifteen miles east of them, a PLAN group is closing at eighteen knots: a Type 054A, a Type 056A and the Type 071 Changbai Shan, which has been carrying stores for the Biak enclave. The 054A's YJ-83A reaches eighty-five miles, and she is closing on Hyuga to use it.

VIPER 51 to 54, JASDF F-2As from the Langgur detachment, are airborne with four ASM-3 each. JAMMER 71, an EC-2 of the Electronic Warfare Operations Group, is on station south of the group to jam the frigate's search and fire-control radars while they run in.
Sink the 054A and the 056A. The Japanese ships are weapons tight under their own rules and will defend themselves. A Pelni ferry and Banda fishing boats are in the same water.
COMMAND NET: A mission-specific tactical report follows eight minutes after the start. It is advice from the command team, not a new sensor detection.
Commodore Alex Mercer; Colonel Kenji Arai, JASDF, Langgur detachment
COMMANDER'S INTENT

Tokyo's rules: the F-2As go because Hyuga is threatened, and only at the ships that threaten her. That is the Type 054A and the 056A with the landing ship. Arai has four aircraft and four missiles each, and the EC-2 to blind the frigate's radar while they run in. Sink the two warships; the landing ship is a bonus, and I would rather nobody chases it into Seram's waters.
• Sink the Type 054A and the Type 056A
• JS Hyuga is not hit
• Sink the Type 071
• Lose no F-2A
• Harm no ferry or fishing boat
Four JASDF F-2A with ASM-3 and an EC-2 jammer; JS Hyuga with her SH-60K and JS Asahi. Opposing: a Type 054A, a Type 056A and the Type 071 Changbai Shan. Neutral: a Pelni ferry and fishing boats.

The planned window is 75 minutes. At that minute Command signals that you are behind schedule and holds the line for about 37 minutes more; the operation is closed at 112 minutes and the main task will be recorded as failed.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT
All designated neutral contacts are protected. A protected neutral loss cancels the operation. Identify before you shoot.
